WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(NUMERIC(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),CREDITDISCOUNTPERCENT)),0) CREDITDISCOUNTPERCENT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),DEBITDISCOUNTPERCENT)),0) DEBITDISCOUNTPERCENT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),WITHHOLDTAXFLOORLMT)),0) WITHHOLDTAXFLOORLMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),WITHHOLDTAXPCNT)),0) WITHHOLDTAXPCNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT1)),0) AMOUNT1_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CATCHUP_MISCELLANEOUSINFO WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, CREDITDISCOUNTPERCENT CREDITDISCOUNTPERCENT_src
, DEBITDISCOUNTPERCENT DEBITDISCOUNTPERCENT_src
, WITHHOLDTAXFLOORLMT WITHHOLDTAXFLOORLMT_src
, WITHHOLDTAXPCNT WITHHOLDTAXPCNT_src
, AMOUNT1 AMOUNT1_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_CATCHUP_MISCELLANEOUSINFO WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, CREDITDISCOUNTPERCENT_tgt
, DEBITDISCOUNTPERCENT_tgt
, WITHHOLDTAXFLOORLMT_tgt
, WITHHOLDTAXPCNT_tgt
, AMOUNT1_tgt
, CREDITDISCOUNTPERCENT_src
, DEBITDISCOUNTPERCENT_src
, WITHHOLDTAXFLOORLMT_src
, WITHHOLDTAXPCNT_src
, AMOUNT1_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT 
  CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS COUNT_SRC
, CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS COUNT_TGT
, CAST(CREDITDISCOUNTPERCENT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS CREDITDISCOUNTPERCENT_tgt
, CAST(DEBITDISCOUNTPERCENT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS DEBITDISCOUNTPERCENT_tgt
, CAST(WITHHOLDTAXFLOORLMT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS WITHHOLDTAXFLOORLMT_tgt
, CAST(WITHHOLDTAXPCNT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS WITHHOLDTAXPCNT_tgt
, CAST(AMOUNT1_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS AMOUNT1_tgt
, CAST(CREDITDISCOUNTPERCENT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS CREDITDISCOUNTPERCENT_src
, CAST(DEBITDISCOUNTPERCENT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS DEBITDISCOUNTPERCENT_src
, CAST(WITHHOLDTAXFLOORLMT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS WITHHOLDTAXFLOORLMT_src
, CAST(WITHHOLDTAXPCNT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS WITHHOLDTAXPCNT_src
, CAST(AMOUNT1_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS AMOUNT1_src
, FILE_NAME
, INSERT_DTTM
, DATE
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, CREDITDISCOUNTPERCENT_src
, DEBITDISCOUNTPERCENT_src
, WITHHOLDTAXFLOORLMT_src
, WITHHOLDTAXPCNT_src
, AMOUNT1_src
)
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, CREDITDISCOUNTPERCENT_tgt
, DEBITDISCOUNTPERCENT_tgt
, WITHHOLDTAXFLOORLMT_tgt
, WITHHOLDTAXPCNT_tgt
, AMOUNT1_tgt
)
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
